messages.subject: How to modify the userReadSwatOutput.R in the source code
parts:
Respected Sir,

I wish to calibrate the hydrologic inflow for my reservoir in the SWAT and SWAT+ model using R-SWAT. But I don't know how to modify the userReadSwatOutput.R. I have watched your tutorial. I understood the basic concept but unfortunately you have modified the RSWAT recently. Could you please help me to make changes in the userReadSwatOutput.R for extracting reservoir flow_in cumec in from RES =1 from the output.rsv


Regards,
Sreeraj
